spec_features.spec_quote: The session can end early if the agent explicitly gives up or asks to stop
spec_features.evidence: Mentioned only in DESIGN.md sec 4. No runner loop exists anywhere. client.py only has run_turn() (one API call, no loop). No exit/give-up tool, no handler, no 'abandoned' status assignment. Session.status field (client.py:21) is never set by any code path. grep for stop/exit/abandon/give up finds nothing in code beyond the status field name. config.py, judge.py, models/__init__.py are all empty (0 bytes).
spec_features.notes: Tools list is merely passed through to the API in run_turn; no tools are defined or dispatched. No conversation/episode loop exists to be ended.

spec_features.evidence: The value 20 appears only in DESIGN.md sec 4 prose. grep for '20', 'max_turn', 'while', 'for ... in range', 'loop' in *.py returns no match (only run_turn def name). There is no loop and no turn-cap check anywhere; client.py performs a single chat.completions.create with no enclosing iteration. turn_number is computed as len(messages)+1 (client.py:~84) but never compared to a limit or used to break.
spec_features.notes: No constant for max turns exists in code at all; the cap is pure spec prose.
